findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "marketplace-health" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: marketplace-health_payout-hold-diagnose, marketplace-health_account-restriction-evidence-check, marketplace-health_seller-appeal-evidence-build · Private data: marketplace-health_payout-hold-diagnose, marketplace-health_account-restriction-evidence-check · Public sink: marketplace-health_account-notice-extract, marketplace-health_seller-performance-metric-analyze, marketplace-health_payout-hold-diagnose, marketplace-health_account-restriction-evidence-check, marketplace-health_policy-issue-classify, marketplace-health_seller-appeal-evidence-build, marketplace-health_account-risk-report, marketplace-health_notice-response-draft · Destructive: marketplace-health_account-notice-extract, marketplace-health_seller-performance-metric-analyze, marketplace-health_payout-hold-diagnose, marketplace-health_account-restriction-evidence-check, marketplace-health_policy-issue-classify, marketplace-health_seller-appeal-evidence-build, marketplace-health_account-risk-report, marketplace-health_notice-response-draft.
